ablation.scope: Successful-pair conditional descriptive analysis. v3 same-state reconstruction uses preceding basket and frozen history; v4 compares logged full input states. Not a randomized clinical effect.

matched_protocol_difference.scope: Selected-case, scenario-paired exploratory comparison; no correction of historical prompt information.

stage4_v4.scope: Selected scripted LASI profiles; no Stage 1 external validation, national weighted effectiveness, clinical benefit or proof of general LLM superiority. Successful-pair ablation and empirical bootstrap are conditional analyses.
